memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Chronic insomnia.
Patient reports difficulty falling asleep, frequent awakenings, and non‑restorative sleep for the past 3 months, associated with daytime fatigue and irritability; she denies snoring or witnessed apneas. Examination shows a calm, well‑appearing woman, vitals normal, no nasal congestion or throat abnormalities. Insomnia Severity Index score is 18 (moderate insomnia). TSH and haemoglobin are ordered to rule out contributory medical causes. Plan: start melatonin 3 mg at bedtime and trazodone 50 mg at bedtime, sleep hygiene counselling, and follow‑up in 8 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH: 2.1 mIU/L (ref 0.4‑4.0).
Haemoglobin: 13.2 g/dL (ref 12.0‑16.0).
Insomnia Severity Index score: 18 (self‑reported).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 50 mg HS

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been sleeping better since starting the melatonin and trazodone – I fall asleep within 20 minutes and wake only once. However I feel a bit groggy in the mornings and wonder if we could lower the trazodone dose. My daytime energy has improved but I still get tired after lunch.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Insomnia, improving.
Patient reports reduced sleep latency, fewer night awakenings, and mild morning grogginess; daytime fatigue lessened. Examination unchanged, vitals stable. Insomnia Severity Index score now 12 (borderline normal). TSH remains 2.0 mIU/L, haemoglobin 13.0 g/dL. Plan: reduce trazodone to 25 mg HS to lessen grogginess, continue melatonin, reinforce sleep hygiene, review in 2 months.

Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 25 mg HS

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Insomnia, mild residual symptoms.
Patient notes occasional difficulty staying asleep and mild daytime tiredness; ISI score 14 indicates subthreshold insomnia. Examination normal, vitals within limits. Haemoglobin slightly low at 12.4 g/dL suggestive of mild iron deficiency; TSH normal. Plan: continue melatonin 3 mg HS and trazodone 25 mg HS, add ferrous sulfate 325 mg OD for anemia, re‑check labs in 8 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 25 mg HS
Ferrous sulfate 325 mg OD

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment scheduled for 2026-02-20 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon for insomnia follow‑up.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Insomnia, well controlled.
Patient reports sleep latency <15 minutes, minimal awakenings, refreshed mornings; ISI score 9 (normal). Haemoglobin now 13.5 g/dL after iron supplementation, TSH 2.0 mIU/L. Plan: maintain melatonin 3 mg HS and trazodone 25 mg HS, continue ferrous sulfate until Hb >14 g/dL, then taper. Review in 4 months.
